name: Avtostopom po fantaziyam
source:
Aliens flew to the planet Terra on vacation.

But will they be able to rest when humans have once again done something wrong with their planet?

Will the guests have the courage not to run away, but to find out what is happening?

[Translated from [url=https://annarosh.itch.io/hitchhikers-guide-to-fantasy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
外星人飞往泰拉星球度假。

但当人类再次对他们的星球做错事时，他们还能安息吗？

客人们有勇气不逃跑，而是去查明发生了什么吗？

[译自[url=https://annarosh.itch.io/hitchhikers-guide-to-fantasy]itch.io[/url]]
